Title: General availability: Visual Studio App Center

Body.Content:
Visual Studio App Center is now generally available.

With App Center, you can automate the lifecycle of your iOS, Android, Windows, and macOS apps. Connect your repo and within minutes build in the cloud, test on thousands of real devices, distribute to beta testers and app stores, and monitor real-world usage with crash and analytics data.

To learn more, visit the App Center webpage.
